title_zh: 选定成人影迷放映影片并修正宣传定位

scenario.label_zh: 成人影迷活动放映简介
scenario.goal_zh: 选定以人物关系为主的爱情片，约定删去海报上夸大的性感宣传标签并补充慢节奏说明

context_zh: 成年影迷小组为仅限成人的周末活动选择虚构电影并讨论简介。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: Is this a romance, or is the love story just a small part of it?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: The relationship is the main story, but most of it is quiet conversation.

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: Then calling it a sexy film on our poster seems misleading. The trailer makes it look much more heated than it is.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: I agree. For this screening, people should know they are choosing a slow character drama.

sentences.speaker: Tessa
sentences.text: That sounds right for our adult group. Shall we choose it and describe it as a quiet romance?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Yes. I'll remove the word from the poster and add a note about the pace, so people know what to expect.
